lines.zh: 我六条腿交替落地，节奏很稳。
lines.en: Six legs land in turn, steady rhythm.

lines.zh: 脖子上一圈环纹随步子晃。
lines.en: The ringed pattern on my neck sways with each step.
I follow the seams between stones.
The front pairs probe; the rear pushes.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，钻进矮树丛。
lines.en: I keep low and push into the scrub.

lines.zh: 六只脚踩在沙上，像一串鼓点。
lines.en: Six feet on sand, like a drumbeat.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都压出一条路。
lines.en: I leave a pressed path through the grass.
I stop and lift my tail.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块突起的岩层。
lines.en: I skirt an outcrop.
Not fast, but rarely a misstep.

lines.zh: 我的环颈在光下一圈圈发亮。
lines.en: My banded neck gleams ring by ring.
I work my way down the slope.

lines.zh: 我一条腿悬着，先试了试。
lines.en: One leg hovers, testing first.

lines.zh: 我转身，六条腿要挪两回。
lines.en: To turn, I have to shuffle all six legs.

lines.zh: 风把草吹倒，我趁势前行。
lines.en: The wind flattens the grass and I move with it.
I reach the water's edge and lower my head.

lines.zh: 我六条腿撑开，稳稳站着。
lines.en: I stand planted on six legs.

lines.zh: 脖子上的环纹慢慢起伏。
lines.en: The rings on my neck rise and fall.
I raise my head and look far off.

lines.zh: 风从我的背甲上滑过去。
lines.en: Wind slides over my back plates.
I tuck one leg beneath me.
I chew the grass in my mouth.
The soil tastes of salt.
I scratch my neck ring with a hind leg.

lines.zh: 六条腿让它站得比四条的稳。
lines.en: Six legs stand steadier than four.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草，看坡下的影子。
lines.en: I chew grass and watch the shadows down the slope.
Shade falls across my back.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖耳朵后面的皮。
lines.en: I twitch the skin behind my ear.
A kin grazes in the distance.

lines.zh: 我嚼一半停下，听坡上的草响。
lines.en: I stop mid-chew to listen to the grass on the slope.
I paw the soil with a leg.
Dirt sifts between my toes.
I raise my head; none of my six legs move.

lines.zh: 你站在我侧面，看得清楚。
lines.en: You stand at my flank, in plain view.
Head tilted, I study your hands.

lines.zh: 我把环颈抬高，与你平视。
lines.en: I raise my ringed neck to look you level in the eye.
My banded neck is turned to you.
Your hands smell of iron and smoke.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，六条腿错开。
lines.en: I step back, legs shuffling.
I tilt my neck and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我低下脖子，凑近看了看。
lines.en: I lower my neck and look closer.
Your boots carry soil from elsewhere.
The rings turn as my neck turns.
You want to touch me? Not yet.
My six legs buckle.
I lurch to one side.
That landed on my back plate.
I let out a low hum and back away.
I draw my neck in.
Two steps back before I'm steady.
Blood on my banded neck.
A sharp ache throbs under my back plate.
I can still walk.
I'd like to be further from you.
Those leaves smell good.
Are those shoots in your hand?

lines.zh: 我挪了两步，六条腿有点乱。
lines.en: I shuffle two steps, legs tangling.
I rise on my front legs and still cannot reach.
Don't hold it so high.
I eat slowly. Wait.

lines.zh: 这味道比我啃过的草好。
lines.en: This tastes better than the grass I've had.
I lower my head, eyes still on you.
Step back so I can eat.
It's a bit tough to chew.
More? I can still eat.

lines.zh: 我跟着你手里的叶子走。
lines.en: I follow the leaves in your hand.
Chasing on six legs isn't easy.

lines.zh: 叶子在你手里晃，我盯着。
lines.en: The leaf sways in your hand and I stare at it.

lines.zh: 叶子在我嘴里卷成一条。
lines.en: The leaf rolls up into a tube in my mouth.

lines.zh: 那股嫩芽味一飘过来，我脖子就伸长了。
lines.en: The smell of young shoots drifts over and my neck stretches out.

lines.zh: 你撞在我侧面，我晃了晃。
lines.en: You hit my flank and I sway.
Six legs held. I didn't fall.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，我调整了站姿。
lines.en: You're thrown back; I reset my stance.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的步子打乱了。
lines.en: That broke my stride.
I take two steps back and plant myself.
You bumped my banded neck.
Bone on bone, one sharp sound.

lines.zh: 我站稳了，你也只是晃了晃。
lines.en: I hold my footing; you only wobble.
Watch where you walk.
I go back to grazing.
A kin on the slope; I see it.

lines.zh: 我走过去，六条腿慢慢挪。
lines.en: I walk over, six legs shifting slowly.
We sniff each other's necks.
Its rings are closer than mine.
We graze side by side.
Six legs apiece makes for a tight fit.
It leaves first.
Its rings vanish beyond the slope.
This slope can feed us both.
There will be young next year.
I take a tuft of grass in my mouth.
I pin it with a foreleg to lift it.
This is a little damp.
I shake it out.
The leaves scatter and I pick them up one by one.
The stalk is too long and drags on the ground.
Too tough to bite through.
I press it under a stone.
I'll keep this for the road.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，我说不出话。
lines.en: My mouth is full; I can't speak.
A rustle in the grass.
I turn my head that way.
My six legs grow restless.
I know that smell.
Not one of mine.
I back half a step and lower myself.

lines.zh: 它的影子盖住了半片坡。
lines.en: Its shadow covers half the slope.
I pull my neck back.
If it comes, I run.

lines.zh: 六条腿跑起来其实不慢。
lines.en: Six legs can move when they must.
The grass tips are still moving; it has not gone far.

lines.zh: 我侧着脖子，用一只眼看。
lines.en: I turn my neck sideways to watch with one eye.
It goes left; I go right.

lines.zh: 我六条腿挪了两次才对上它。
lines.en: It takes two shuffles of all six legs to face it squarely.
It stops on the ridge, and so do I.
I stamp the soil underfoot.
It's backed off a little.
I move slowly up the slope.
It hasn't followed.

lines.zh: 坡上安静下来，我低头吃草。
lines.en: The slope goes quiet and I lower my head to graze.

lines.zh: 我抬起前腿拍开你的手。
lines.en: I lift a front leg and slap your hand away.

lines.zh: 脖子甩过去，撞在它身上。
lines.en: I swing my neck into it.
That was only to push it away.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，牙不够锋利。
lines.en: I bite, but my teeth are blunt.

lines.zh: 顶开它之后，我转身就溜。
lines.en: After shoving it off, I turn and bolt.
Six legs keep me planted.
Fighting isn't my strength.
After the shove, I run downhill.
That should be enough, right?
I lower my head and keep grazing.
I emerge from the scrub.

lines.zh: 六条腿在碎石上找了找位置。
lines.en: Six legs find their footing on the gravel.
Dirt clings to my banded neck.
This slope is wide open.

lines.zh: 我咬断一根带露水的草。
lines.en: I bite through a stem beaded with dew.
It'll do.
A kin walks in the distance.

lines.zh: 我迈开六条腿，慢慢过去。
lines.en: I set all six legs going and head over slowly.
Six legs look clumsy when they walk.
But they're steady.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背甲，我拼命跑。
lines.en: Fire scorches my back plate and I run.
All six legs fold on landing.

lines.zh: 水没过我的脖子，我拼命划。
lines.en: Water covers my neck; I paddle hard.

lines.zh: 炸起的土把我埋到脖子。
lines.en: The dirt thrown up by the blast buries me to the neck.
An arrow bites my flank.
Light binds my legs and I can't move.
Hunger leaves all six legs weak.

lines.zh: 雷落在坡上，我六腿齐软。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the slope and all six of my legs go weak.
The ground vanishes and I fall.
